identification: Antique style cast iron reclining barber's chair with pierced cast footrest, scroll base, worn brown and black leather-type upholstery with brass studs. No maker visible; late 19th or early 20th century look. Koken is the main US maker but nothing here confirms it.

viewing_check: Look for a maker's plate or cast mark (Koken, Kochs, Theo A Kochs, Emil Paidar, Berninghaus) on the base, under the seat and on the footrest; check the hydraulic or ratchet mechanism works, any cracked or repaired castings, and whether it is original or a later reproduction. Photograph the underside and any marks.
